/** Before legacy serialization/validators can coerce or invoke output data. */
function prepareCompleteToolResult(raw) {
	let safe;
	try {
		const text = (0,__vite_ssr_import_1__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(raw, LARGE_LIMITS);
		safe = JSON.parse(text);
		if (!safe || Array.isArray(safe) || ![
			"SUCCEEDED",
			"FAILED",
			"REJECTED"
		].includes(safe.status)) throw new Error("shape");
		if (safe.error !== undefined && (typeof safe.error !== "string" || safe.error.length > 512)) throw new Error("error");
	} catch {
		// The body may already have acted; do not turn capture failure into safe replay.
		throw new Error("unknown_effect: complete_result_not_representable");
	};
	return {
		status: safe.status,
		...Object.hasOwn(safe, "output") ? { output: safe.output } : {},
		...typeof safe.error === "string" ? { error: safe.error } : {}
	};
};
function prepareCompleteToolRegistry(registry) {
	const prepare = (tool) => tool ? {
		...tool,
		execute: async (...args) => prepareCompleteToolResult(await tool.execute(...args))
	} : undefined;
	return {
		list: () => registry.list().map((tool) => prepare(tool)),
		resolve: (id, version) => prepare(registry.resolve(id, version))
	};
};

function assertCompleteToolObservation(observation) {
	if (observation.type !== "TOOL_RESULT") return;
	const raw = observation.payload;
	// Validate plain JSON before reading individual fields; never invoke accessors.
	completeSnapshot(raw);
	const payload = raw;
	if (!payload || payload.schemaVersion !== 1 || observation.source !== "TOOL" || observation.trust !== "UNTRUSTED" || ![

	};

			throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.ToolResultContextError("STATE_CONFLICT", "Tool result integrity mismatch.", "STATE_CONFLICT");
		}
	} else if (payload.status === "SUCCEEDED" && payload.completion === "UNAVAILABLE") {
		if (payload.resultAvailability !== "UNAVAILABLE" || ![
			"INVALID_JSON",
			"RESULT_TOO_LARGE",
			"RESULT_COMPLEXITY"

		}
	} else if (payload.status !== "FAILED" && payload.status !== "REJECTED" || payload.completion !== "NOT_APPLICABLE" || payload.resultAvailability !== "UNAVAILABLE" || typeof payload.error !== "string" || payload.error.length > 512 || Object.keys(payload).sort().join(",") !== "completion,error,resultAvailability,schemaVersion,sideEffect,status") {
		throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.ToolResultContextError("STATE_CONFLICT", "Invalid failed tool result.", "STATE_CONFLICT");
	};

		observation.observationId,
		observation.executionId,
		observation.stepId,

		observation.provenance.operationKey,

function retainCompleteObservations(observations) {
	const retained = [...observations];
	while (retained.length > __vite_ssr_import_1__.MAX_CHECKPOINT_OBSERVATIONS) {
		const optional = retained.findIndex((value) => value.type !== "TOOL_RESULT");
		if (optional < 0) {
			throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.ToolResultContextError("CONTEXT_OVERFLOW", "No checkpoint slot for another complete tool result.");
		};
		retained.splice(optional, 1);
	};
	return retained;
};
/** Validate a custom selector against native items and immutable runtime facts. */
function validateCompleteStepContext(actual, native) {
	completeSnapshot(actual);
	for (const key of [
		"executionId",
		"tenantId",
		"conversationId",
		"stepNumber",
		"runtimeProfile",
		"agentId",
		"agentVersion",
		"objective",
		"instructions",
		"goal",
		"userMessage",
		"stateSummary",

		"capabilities",
		"knowledgeAvailable",
		"completionStrategy",
		"allowedDecisionTypes",
		"budget",
		"budgetUsage",
		"pendingApprovalId",
		"pendingQuestion",
		"lastEvaluation",
		"correlationId",
		"traceId",
		"decisionRepair",
		"toolResultContext"
	]) {
		if (completeSnapshot(actual[key] ?? null) !== completeSnapshot(native[key] ?? null)) {
			throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.ToolResultContextError("STATE_CONFLICT", `Context changed native field ${key}.`, "STATE_CONFLICT");
		}
	};
	if (!Number.isSafeInteger(actual.tokenBudget) || actual.tokenBudget < 1) {
		throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.ToolResultContextError("ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE", "Invalid context token bound.");
	};
	const nativeItems = new Map(native.contextItems.map((value) => [value.contextId, value]));
	const actualIds = new Set();
	for (const item of actual.contextItems) {
		const expected = nativeItems.get(item.contextId);
		if (actualIds.has(item.contextId) || !expected || completeSnapshot(item) !== completeSnapshot(expected)) {
			throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.ToolResultContextError("STATE_CONFLICT", "Context item changed or duplicated native data.", "STATE_CONFLICT");
		};
		actualIds.add(item.contextId);
	};
	for (const item of native.contextItems) {
		if ([
			"SYSTEM",
			"AGENT_PROFILE",
			"CURRENT_GOAL",
			"CURRENT_STATE",
			"FRESH_TOOL_RESULTS"
		].includes(item.priority) && !actualIds.has(item.contextId)) {
			throw new __vite_ssr_import_1__.ToolResultContextError("CONTEXT_OVERFLOW", "A mandatory context item was omitted.");
		}
	}
}
